takeaway: Supraspinatus initiates abduction; infraspinatus and teres minor externally rotate; subscapularis internally rotates and inserts on the lesser tuberosity.

question.text: Concerning the rotator cuff muscles, which of the following statements is correct?

answer.text: Teres minor is an external rotator of the shoulder.

lines.text: Four muscles form the rotator cuff around the shoulder joint.
Supraspinatus inserts on the greater tuberosity and initiates abduction.
Infraspinatus also inserts on the greater tuberosity, and rotates the shoulder externally.
Teres minor sits below it, same insertion, same job: an external rotator.
Subscapularis is the odd one out. It inserts on the lesser tuberosity and rotates internally.
So the answer is A: teres minor is an external rotator.
